units.source_text: 再没有什么比干这种事更腻味的了。

en.t: Nothing could be more sickening than doing this sort of thing.

units.source_text: 吃完饭，我揭开病人的被子，用夜壶给他接尿。

en.t: After the meal, I lifted the sick man's quilt and used a chamber pot to catch his urine.

units.source_text: 十分钟过去了，还没尿出来。

en.t: Ten minutes passed, and still no urine came out.
That showed how weak his abdomen had become.

units.source_text: 等候时，我满腹牢骚，说了些令人讨厌的话。

en.t: While I waited, I was full of complaints and said some unpleasant things.

units.source_text: 这些话当然是脱口而出的。

en.t: Those words, of course, slipped out before I could stop them.
Then Grandfather bowed his head and apologized.

units.source_text: 我眼看他一天天地消瘦下去，脸上笼罩着苍白的死影，不由得感到很惭愧。

en.t: Watching him grow thinner day by day, with the pale shadow of death settling over his face, I could not help feeling ashamed.

units.source_text: 过了很久，他用又细又尖的声音喊道：

en.t: After a long while, he cried out in a thin, sharp voice:
